name: Indian Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark
description: A dataset and evaluation suite of Indian traffic sign images designed to support training and benchmarking of traffic-sign recognition algorithms for Indian road scenarios.
evaluation_method: accuracy (classification) and mean Average Precision (mAP) for detection where applicable
reputation: Regionally relevant benchmark used in Indian traffic-sign recognition research but less widely adopted than international datasets (e.g., GTSRB).
notes: Class imbalance, varying illumination and sign damage/occlusion common; dataset size and diversity may be limited compared to large international corpora.
